title: How Going To The Bathroom Turned into a Felony
description:
On January 23rd, 2023, officers responded to a health clinic in reference to a 5 year old child who was left alone by her mother for over 45 minutes. The offender did not speak any English and was oblivious to the fact that she had abandoned her child. Even with a translator, the female was having difficulty communicating with the officers. They decided to detain her for child neglect and after getting cuffed, she started laughing maniacally. The female was a Venezuelan immigrant who had recently moved to Florida. She also spat on an officer after being transported to jail. The  female was identified as 31-year-old Andriena. She was charged with battery on a law enforcement officer, resisting arrest without violence and child neglect. Her daughter was safely handed over to Child Protective Services.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
